## Summary

Describe the user-visible or security outcome and why this is the smallest complete change.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated tests for the changed outcome.
- [ ] `make check` passes, or I explained why it could not run.
- [ ] `make test` passes, or I explained why it could not run.
- [ ] Specs and module documentation are aligned with behavior.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, personal data, or private operational material.
- [ ] Every commit has a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).

## Security and operations

Describe changes to authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, attestation, egress policy, secret handling, migrations, workflows, images, or deployment behavior. Write `None` when none apply.
